Bill.BriefDescription: Concerning measuring devices for small water withdrawals.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to measurement devices for small water withdrawals;and adding a new section to chapter 90.44 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 90.44 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: If a well authorized under the provisions of RCW 90.44.050 isrequired to be metered, the department shall bear the full cost ofinstallation and periodic maintenance of the measuring device. Thedepartment must work with the landowner to identify a mutuallyagreeable time for the installation and maintenance work to becompleted, and unless agreed to by the landowner, the department mustprovide no less than thirty days' notice to the owner of the wellbefore entering the property for installation and maintenance.
